boundaries: 52 recognized CSRs; GuardedMachineContext requires caller machine_only and no MPRV. MPP is not actual mode.
PMA TYPE0 denies matching accesses; OFF is no match. Guest NA4 and unsupported fields reject transactionally.
PMA POR A2/type0/addr0 remains tagged and its low128B window is unsupported.
Unaligned TOR edges, sub128B NAPOT and the UINT32MAX tail have local unsupported windows; ambiguous address readback is unsupported.
PMA overlap priority and an unlocked predecessor of a locked PMA TOR are not guessed.
PMP lowest matching entry covers the entire access; locked TOR also freezes predecessor address. XL remains unsupported.
AtomicRead/LR requiresR, AtomicWrite/SC requiresW, AtomicRmw requiresRW; Bus decides whether a target supports atomics.
Attrs are diagnostic for a coherent no-line model; no physical cache/tap/latency claim.
Snapshots are bounded/read-only with epoch/generation; no restore API or user-metadata construction.
No shared lib/state/exec/Bus wiring, DMA permission application, WASM build, full emulator/native run, benchmark, golden update or publication in this change.
